item.title: Saturday 4 PM Update, Oct 24
item.description:
The Saturday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 24, 2026: a State Department press adviser resigns after a courtside altercation, the first U.S. wildlife case of New World screwworm and Six Flags adds seat belts after a fatal coaster fall; France's protest day ends with nearly a thousand arrests, Iran's president says talks should resume as a U.S. carrier group rearms, and Israel heads into Tuesday's election; a fatal Tesla FSD crash in Vallejo and Getty Images' prepackaged bankruptcy; the FBI weighs an espionage charge against an ex-OpenAI engineer and DeepSeek raises fifteen billion dollars; an abandoned Popcorn Time updater left millions exposed; your X feed; Maine marks three years since Lewiston as heating oil hits a record; and a bystander stops a runaway school bus. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Saturday 1 PM Update, Oct 24

item.title: Friday 4 PM Update, Oct 23
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
